overview_description.description:
AT SDCEE, We believe that entrepreneurship is the primary driving force for innovation and sustainable economic growth. To this end—in collaboration with Erasmus Centre for Entrepreneurship, Dubai Technology Entrepreneur Campus (Dtec), and Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO) —we have launched the SD Centre for Entrepreneurship Excellence (SDCEE).

Located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, SDCEE is the premier centre for individuals looking to build and develop their entrepreneurial skills to create a successful venture.

With over 200+ years of collective industrial experience of its founders and mentors, SDCEE is focused towards promoting entrepreneurial excellence through exceptional mentorship, entrepreneurship training programs, and consulting services.

Our programs have been designed to combine rigorous, updated curriculum with practical learning to maximize real-world application and impact.

about_short_description.short_description: SDCEE is the premier centre for individuals looking to build and develop their entrepreneurial skills to create a successful venture.

product.name: SDCEE Startup Program
product.description: A program designed for individuals aiming to start their entrepreneurial journey, offering short-term courses to strategize and initiate business ideas.

product.name: SDCEE Scaleup Program
product.description: This program focuses on assisting entrepreneurs in scaling their businesses, addressing challenges such as leadership, talent development, and growth financing.

product.name: SDCEE Young Startup Entrepreneur Program
product.description: A 12-month acceleration program for students 15 and above, aiming to develop entrepreneurial skills and provide a business license for setting up ventures in Dubai.

product.name: Space for Business Program
product.description: A six-month course, followed by a two-day bootcamp, focusing on scaling businesses in the space industry, covering innovation strategy and leadership.

product.name: Dash Venture Labs Incubation Programme
product.description: An incubation program aimed at enhancing personal entrepreneurial skills and supporting startup growth through various developmental stages.
